PluginLibraryModule.cards.title: Humanizer
PluginLibraryModule.cards.shortDescription: Strip AI-writing tells from prose in any language.
PluginLibraryModule.cards.shortDescriptionZh: 去除文本的 AI 味，把行文改成书籍、报纸、百科式的风格，任何语言通用。

quickStart.prompt: Rewrite this so it reads like edited human writing: "In today's fast-paced world, it is important to note that leveraging cutting-edge solutions can unlock a myriad of opportunities and drive meaningful impact across diverse domains."
quickStart.promptZh: 把这段话改写成像经过编辑的人写的文字：「在当今快速发展的时代，值得注意的是，借助前沿解决方案能够解锁无数机遇，并在多元领域推动有意义的影响。」
